capabilities: Create and edit .sc poetry files through a form UI
Annotate characters with pinyin via a syllable keyboard
Render poetry, prose, and vertical right-to-left layouts
Export rendered poems as standalone HTML files
disambiguation: Despite the name, it does not print; it edits and typesets poems on screen and exports them as HTML files.
extras: README and UI are entirely in Chinese; no marketplace install path is described, so users must build from source and copy files into the plugins folder manually. Embedding .sc files into other notes is not yet supported.
problem: Obsidian's plain Markdown editing offers no way to author or render traditional Chinese typography such as vertical text, character spacing, or pinyin annotations.

relations.evidence: 基于 赫蹏 (Heti) 的 Obsidian 古文诗词排版插件

summary: Form-based editor that typesets classical Chinese poetry and prose using Heti, with pinyin ruby annotation, vertical layout, and HTML export.
